title: loop
responsibility: Registers loop lifecycle, regression proof, sibling sweeps, security review, changed-code review, and evaluator commands.

inputs.name: registerLoopCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander program that receives the `loop` command, which the function adds with `program.command('loop')`. The function keeps no reference to it, so it matters only while registration runs, and it must be a Commander `Command` because `.command()` is the only method the function calls on it.

inputs.name: registerLoopSecurityCommands.parent
inputs.description: The Commander loop command that receives the security command group.

inputs.name: registerLoopSiblingCommands.parent
inputs.description: The Commander loop command that receives the siblings and review-bugs subcommands.

outputs.name: registerLoopCommand
outputs.description: Registers loop lifecycle, regression proof, evaluation, sibling sweeps, changed-code review, and security review without executing a subcommand.

errors.name: Invalid review request
errors.description: Rejects conflicting review options, malformed sibling origins, or repair requests that omit their required loop or test command.

errors.name: InvalidArgumentError
errors.description: Commander rejects invalid candidate counts, review durations, or USD amounts before running the subcommand.
